question: Where is the nearest café ahead of In the Game - Hollywood Park, Crestwood, IL toward Norwood Park Historical Society, Chicago, IL?
sql: WITH locations AS ( SELECT (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%In the Game - Hollywood Park%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Crestwood%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%IL%' LIMIT 1) AS start_geom, (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Norwood Park Historical Society%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Chicago%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%IL%' LIMIT 1) AS end_geom ), azimuth_calc AS ( SELECT start_geom, end_geom, degrees(ST_Azimuth(start_geom, end_geom)) AS target_azimuth FROM locations WHERE start_geom IS NOT NULL AND end_geom IS NOT NULL ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p, azimuth_calc AS ac WHERE p.amenity = 'cafe' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ac.start_geom::geography, 50000) -- Search within 50km radius from the start point AND abs(degrees(atan2(sin(radians(degrees(ST_Azimuth(ac.start_geom, p.geometry)) - ac.target_azimuth)), cos(radians(degrees(ST_Azimuth(ac.start_geom, p.geometry)) - ac.target_azimuth))))) <= 45 -- Filter for cafes within +/- 45 degrees of the target direction ORDER BY ST_Distance(ac.start_geom::geography, p.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
